description: Architecture / conformance audit manifest (ARCH-AUDIT-*, ADR-000195). Documentation: docs/verification/architecture-audit.md. A check is one entry in 'checks': an existing command with a result parser, a named builtin in tools/audit_system/checks.py, or a documented rule the audit cannot verify yet ('unverified'). Profiles select checks by cost class. Every check names the documented rule it evaluates and the document that states it; the audit adds no rule of its own. Status 'FAIL' is a gate-severity check that does not hold ("severity": "gate"); advisory checks DRIFT. A rule the project has not configured is SKIPPED, never PASS. Project architecture rules are declared in devsys.json "invariants" and evaluated by the builtin architecture_rules; 'project', 'modules' and 'requirements.test_sources' belong to the project; '_example_checks' shows further check kinds and is not loaded.

quick.description: Fast deterministic checks for frequent use: static boundary checks, existing audit scripts, requirement and documentation consistency, recorded test results. No build tree probing beyond reading files, no test execution.

standard.description: Normal development audit: quick plus the build-tree probes (binary boundary, test-binary freshness through run_tests.py --plan, toolchain) and the development-system structure check. No test execution unless --run-tests is given.

baseline.description: Comprehensive snapshot to establish the known state: standard plus the unit tier of every registered suite through scripts/run_tests.py (cached groups are not re-run; stale binaries are reported, never built). Baseline runs are never removed by retention.

cost_classes.fast: deterministic, seconds, reads the repository only
cost_classes.moderate: deterministic, reads the build tree or runs several tools, under a minute
cost_classes.expensive: builds, perf / stress / soak / live / package lanes, containers, hardware: never run by a Phase 1 profile
cost_classes.ai: optional interpretation of the audit packet (--ai); never evidence

checks.title: The project's architecture rules hold (devsys.json invariants, scripts/invariant_check.py)
Every requirement document has an owner row in requirements.txt and every owner row names an existing document
checks.rule: AGENTS.md Authority (use requirements.txt to find the owner); REQ-DEVOPS-004

checks.title: Tests and evidence cite only requirement IDs that a requirement document defines
Every requirement has an identifiable verification mechanism
checks.reason: a requirement no test or evidence record cites may still be verified by a test that does not name it; Phase 1 can only count citations
checks.future_evidence: requirement IDs in test case names or a maintained requirements-trace index

checks.title: Files that the constitution, the documentation index and the current architecture documents name exist
Documentation integrity (links, stale paths, obsolete terms) by scripts/doc_integrity.py
Development-system structure by scripts/verify_development_system.sh (unit tests excluded: the scripts suite runs them)
Every first-party project uses the central warnings-as-errors policy and states no warning flags of its own
checks.reason: PROJECT-SPECIFIC: the source project ran its static warning-policy test here (python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.test_warning_policy); no such test is part of the extraction
checks.future_evidence: a static test that every first-party build file uses the central policy

checks.title: The configured build adapter's tools and tree (scripts/build_health.py)
The audited build tree's test binaries are built from the current sources (scripts/run_tests.py --plan)
checks.reason: a stale or missing binary means the current sources have not been built in this tree, so whether they build (with zero warnings under -Werror) is not known
checks.future_evidence: a build of the current sources in a private tree (scripts/run_tests.py --build) recorded by the audit

checks.title: Release package validation and smoke test (the project's package validation + smoke scripts)
checks.reason: package lane (the project's deployment script); not run by any Phase 1 profile

checks.title: Unit tier (t0 + t1) of every registered suite, executed through scripts/run_tests.py
The latest recorded result of every registered test group in the audited build tree
Integration / GUI (t2, t3) and the perf, stress, soak, live (hardware) and package lanes
checks.reason: long-running, display, hardware or packaging lanes; a Phase 1 audit reports their recorded results only
